entities.name: Type 1 diabetes mellitus
observations: Population of the two cited studies assessing premature ejaculation and glycemic measures.

entities.name: PMID:25424355
observations: In 100 men with Type 1 diabetes aged under 40, HbA1c correlated positively with PEDT score (r=0.27, P=0.006) and negatively with estimated IELT (r=-0.30, P=0.01). PE prevalence was similar to controls (24% vs 23.5%).

entities.name: PMID:33928529
observations: In 112 men aged 18–30 with Type 1 diabetes, PE prevalence was 13% in both high- and low-glucose-variability groups; no significant association with glucose variability was found.

entities.name: HbA1c-PE correlations
observations: A clinical study of men with Type 1 diabetes found modest correlations between higher HbA1c and greater PEDT score (r=0.27) and shorter estimated IELT (r=-0.30); correlation does not establish causation.

entities.name: Glucose variability and PE
observations: A 2021 Type 1 diabetes cohort found no significant association between PE and high versus low short-term glucose variability; prevalence was 13% in each group.
